mapper.select: select attach_id, instance_id, task_id, task_name, file_name, file_url, file_size, uploader_id, uploader_name, create_time from flow_attach where instance_id = #{instanceId} order by create_time desc, attach_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into flow_attach ( instance_id, task_id, task_name, file_name, file_url, file_size, uploader_id, uploader_name, create_time ) values ( #{instanceId}, #{taskId}, #{taskName}, #{fileName}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileSize}, #{uploaderId}, #{uploaderName}, sysdate() )
